title: Super happy with this app!
body:
It’s helped with my burnout recovery, ADHD time blindness and completing tasks which would take a lot longer for me to complete usually. I had no idea how much time I actually have in a day before downloading this app and regularly using it!

Love:
> that it’s easy to duplicate, delete and archive routines 
> that there are routines people have shared that you can use as inspo or directly copy to your own list 
> that you can share your routine publicly with other users
> that you can choose to allow a task to move to the next automatically. There’s plenty of background sounds.
> the various features
> the calendar feature where you can visually see each routine for the day stacked up against the calendar / in a day format. 
> that the developers are continuously improving! Love it the most that the founder responds to emails! 
> that you can use it across devices - but do make sure you’re signed in to all devices using the same log ins and update the app regularly - otherwise the routines won’t sync properly across devices e.g. when you edit a task on one device 

I’ve set up various routines such as: 
> Morning, dinner, night routines
> Chores and errands
> Getting ready for a night out
> Packing for a holiday
> Unpacking from a holiday
> Getting my room neater in 5 mins AM/PM
> Faster morning/night routines 
> Exercise/Cool down routines
> Pep talk routine (I created a 5 min routine where each ‘task’ is actually a positive statements for 5 seconds, like ‘you’re not a bird in a cage!’ ‘Burn that negative thought, put it in the bin! Amazing for my burn out recovery, when I need a boost, and to help me regulate my emotions)
List is endless  

Suggestions for improvements (maybe considered already):
> Seamless looping of background sounds 
> Varied voices in the voice setting options. I only see 1 voice on my device and I find robotic voices jarring sometimes. I tried changing the voice to a natural voice via iPhone’s main text to voice settings but not sure it works like that 
> Video tutorials (YT Shorts preferably) especially following updates and for new features, FAQs
> I’m an Phone and Mac user, but it seems the app is draining my battery fast  - If you forget to switch a routine off, it continues in the background (as designed, so it’s fair!). For us forgetful people, it would help to have a prompt after inactivity to remind us ‘hey, fyi, this routine is still working in the background, are you still completing the routine or do you want to end it?

title: New update is cluttered.
body:
When running a routine, the bottom of the timer screen is now cluttered with the voice assistant, auto-next, context and white noise settings. I would appreciate if the visibility of these could be toggled in settings. 

I’ve also had issues regarding the alarm notification feature; when I open the app it will often only show the pulsating routinery icon and has to be force closed.

As a final niggle, apps such as TickTick allow users to edit what is visible in the tab bar. This feature would make the user experience far more enjoyable in the long run for those who are looking for a simple routine creator app, as opposed to a social app.

I do really appreciate the app, and am aware the problems are relatively small and fixable. But at the moment the app interface makes the subscription somewhat difficult to justify.

title: Routine gives me hope
body:
Struggling with two neurological conditions (ADHD and PTSD), makes it extremely challenging to think clearly and perform well. 
I find Routinely to be thoughtfully designed, with a kind approach to human nature.
I’ve struggled to have a ‘normal life’ for years now, but routinely helps me structure my days when I am in better phases. Tailoring routines to my needs  reminds me that I CAN get things done, even if imperfectly, and that’s hugely encouraging.
Starting the day with Routinely anchors me to my goals in stormy days too, and I manage to achieve much more with my routines than I would without it. Thank you for creating, and for always improving this beautiful tool. It helps to give me hope for my present and my future.

title: Life changing Assistive tech
body:
I have been using this app for 3 months now, and it helped me to change my lifestyle entirely. 

I have pretty bad ADHD and this app is the best in making me do my regular drill without having to think about what comes next. Like, no mental load at all! I use it every day, for morning and evening routines. It is really so great because it also narrates the tasks and times, so I don’t need to be glued to the screen and can just get on with my business and it’s okay if my head is in the clouds. It also helps that ticking tasks is animated and each has an icon. Elements of gamification work wonders with my weird brain. I am still not bored with it after 3 months, because when I feel the routine getting old, I just change it!

Apart from making sure I locked the entrance door and switched off the gas every night, I also noticed that I spend much more time with things that matter to me as part of my routine. Tasks or times set apart for doing things that align with my values. It forced me to think about how I want to live life in general, and gave a shape to experiments with intentionality. I am seriously looking forward to starting every morning, because I will have little islands of peace and celebration programmed in, while also doing the essentials. The streaks also don’t break if I skip tasks sometimes so users are protected from the perfectionism trap while being able to celebrate getting through the routine anyway.
 
I am really grateful for the ad-free design (those would distract me a lot), but I also think the premium tier is affordable. I test a lot of habit management apps and this one is absolutely pro stuff, massive cheers to the developers and everyone that made it happen💚💚💚

title: Notifications stopped after 3 days
body:
Not sure how to get in touch with the developers to ask for support, but they seem pretty active responding to reviews so hoping for some help. 

Recently diagnosed with ADHD, I’ve been looking for something to help me create and consistently follow routines to benefit my physical and mental health. This app came highly recommended through several users via blogs, Reddit posts, and general forums. I wasn’t so keen on the subscription price tag, but the free version lets you build a couple of routines so I figured I’d try it out. 

The app worked great - so much better than expected. Yes a modicum of this success is due to the initial novelty, but the combination of intuitive UI, minimalist display, countdown times and voice reminders meant that I was immediately doing habits daily that I’d been trying to build for years. The app was such a hit with my brain that I decided if I could make it 3 days I would pay for 12 months. 

Then my notifications stopped. I’ve tried reinstalling the app, disabling and re-enabling notifications form system settings and app settings. I’ve set notifications to persistent and set them to remind me every 5 minutes. But the notifications just don’t seem to be firing. 

I’m really hoping there is a fix because for 3 glorious days I actually felt a little like I had my life together, but this app won’t work for me if the onus is on me to remember to launch it. 

Highly recommend giving this app a trial run, and hoping I can get the notification issue sorted so I can give this app the 5 star review I think it deserves.

Two further suggestions along these same lines:

1) Alternative icon sets. I presume the relatively limited range is because you illustrate each one from scratch. Consider offering the ability to use existing large icon sets, e.g. Raindrop.io’s selection.

title: issues
body:
The overall app is quite useful. i have adhd and so struggle with time management and keeping routines, so this was very useful when i found it. HOWEVER, there have been some bugs/issues that have started happening the last few months/weeks.  
Now it just loads and loads when i open it, and unless i open it via a notification on my phone it just doesn’t open. it’s extremely annoying. Sometimes the voice reminder will just give a random step instead of what’s next. For example, “shower will end automatically, get ready for shower “ like??? (wash bath is after shower). it’s most irritating when it says something random like this, but i actually need the next step, e.g. one of the steps is to take my meds - if it says “stretch will end automatically in 1min, move onto brush teeth” but then will use up the Meds time and so has completely defeated the purpose of the reminder. Also, When you stop the routine and get beck to it later (let’s say a few hours) it says “sorry we’re having problems, the tech team are sorting it”,, but if i am to simply swipe skip on all the remaining steps and restart the routine it works?? took a while to get to this loophole. a little disappointing you have to pay for more than 2 routines (and i did consider, but then all these bugs started and i don’t want to pay for something that’s proving to be quite useless). It’s a shame, this didn’t really happen when i first got the app and would be such a massive help if it didn’t have these bugs.

title: A wonderful app!
body:

I do have some possibly improvements

- let me change the colour of the clock face timer. Instead of dark grey on white as if my phone is across the room on charge it’s hard to see how much time I have without breaking focus 

- quick add tasks . Sometimes I might realise while I’m walking my dog that I have extra time before I need to leave for work to do laundry to do or washing up. It would be nice to have a list of maybe 10-15 for quick add tasks . Because when I have to exit and the write the task I get distracted 

-some of the wording I find a little confusing.

You currently have buttons that say this:
“Redo after rest” and “redo from the time ended”

But I think this phrasing is less confusing :
“Restart last task” and “Continue with last task”

title: Is this the best app I’ve ever downloaded?
body:
I’m not prone to exaggerating so please believe me when I say this really might be the best app I’ve ever downloaded. The creators have clearly put a lot of thought into how it works and making it as simple as possible. Here are some things I’ve done since downloading the app:
Left the house on time
Left the house early
Developed new habits and routines without even thinking about it
Done the housework and done it quickly 
Packed my bag and got out of the house without losing anything 

If you struggle with these things you will know how amazing it is to be able to do them. I think the big difference from using an alarm or reminders is the sequencing and moving you from one thing to another. It also really helps when you’re overwhelmed by having so many things to do. I found it really odd for the first few mornings I used it because I’m not used to doing one thing after another without stopping and thinking or getting lost or overwhelmed. 

Developers - if you could change one very small thing it would be to easily reorder several items in the list rather than having to reorder them one at a time. But seriously, what an amazing app.

title: I love it after just one day
body:
First of all, to the developer:  I read your Notion page and it seems like you really made this app through personal passion and research, so kudos! 

Secondly, this is the first routine-developing app that’s actually worked for me. I don’t know if it’s the simplicity, or the timer? But it breaks me out of my indecision paralysis before waking up/going to bed/starting studying. I don’t have ADHD I just really struggle to start anything! 

The only things that I’d note is that it’d be cool to have a feature where you have one, overarching, ‘morning routine’ and then various variations of that morning routine - a shorter one if you wake up late, one if you feel like going on a run, etc. I have the pro version so I know this is possible but it’d be good if when we did one of the various Morning routines, it would tick off the overarching Morning Routine so we know that we DID do a routine that morning even if it was shorter or slightly different. 

Also, I’m not sure about the subscription model for this app. I’m very surprised that it’s not just a one-time payment. 

Other than that, 5*!! Keep up the good work Mr./Ms. Developer!!
